steps.npc: I hate this job. All the other staff are so happy all the time. It depresses me.

steps.player: Why don't you get a new job?

steps.npc: I can't find any other work. I wanted to be a Gnomeball player but I wasn't big enough.

steps.player: That's a shame. I'd better let you get on with your work.
Aren't you going to wish me a nice day?

steps.npc: Have a day. It can be nice if you can be bothered. I know I can't.
